rules: One recipient per execute call (146/146 evidence).

Missing required value -> error code REQUIRED_VALUE_MISSING (payload builder).
Unknown runtime key -> error code UNKNOWN_RUNTIME_KEY (payload builder).
Payloads must be logged redacted (redactPayload): string leaves replaced by length markers, never raw PII.
Customer PII (phone, name, health-related params) handled per Decree 13/2023/ND-CP.

derivationRules: Channel labels resolve to canonical codes per BRD-NHC-001 (ZNS, CHATAPP, SMS, LIVECHAT, BRC_ZALO); APP_PUSH and IN_APP are excluded (Insider-owned).
Blank channel labels are inferred from payload param shape: rich-media keys (type/title/content/url/buttons) -> CHATAPP, otherwise ZNS.
templateKey uses the Zalo TemplateId GUID; when one GUID maps to several catalog entries (content variants), later entries get .variant-<n> suffixes. Rows without a TemplateId get nh.<channel>.<stt>.

params mirror the register payload params (insertion order); for ZNS/SMS, {placeholders} found in content but missing from the payload are appended so the UI preview renders without unresolved tokens.

For rich-media channels (CHATAPP/LIVECHAT/BRC_ZALO), placeholders found inside the content param are NOT added to params (register evidence: 146/146 rich-media payloads carry only type/title/content/url/buttons); they are listed under hubSubstitutedVariables because the Hub substitutes them from customer profile data matched by phone.
addresses is always phone (146/146 payload evidence); recipientFields is always customerId.

Failover composites (ZNS/ SMS Failover, zns/sms, ZNS fail over, ZNS/failover) resolve to primary channel ZNS with failover.channel=SMS; the 'SMS failover' leg is channel=SMS with strategy.role=fallback.
required flags are inferred from the register (every param/address present in the sample payload); confirm with the Notification Hub team before production use.
